faqLeft.q: What engine does the Range Rover Evoque P300e use?
faqLeft.a: The P300e uses the Ingenium AJ200P 2.0-litre 4-cylinder petrol engine paired with an electric motor in a plug-in hybrid configuration. The exact displacement of the petrol component is [MISSING: pending confirmation].

faqLeft.q: How much does a Range Rover Evoque P300e engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Evoque P300e?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact engine specification before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild Evoque P300e engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We rebuild the petrol engine component of the P300e hybrid system as standard.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Evoque P300e engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Evoque P300e if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an Evoque P300e engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Evoque P300e owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
